instructions_to_main_agent: 1. The project uses the farm-ts template (FastAPI backend on port 8001 + React 19 Vite frontend on port 3000 with Tailwind v4).

2. Implement backend CRUD endpoints in /app/backend/routers/apps.py: GET /api/apps (with search/filter/sort params), POST /api/apps, GET /api/apps/{id}, PUT /api/apps/{id}, DELETE /api/apps/{id}, and POST /api/apps/{id}/launch (to increment usage count).
3. Seed the MongoDB database with the ~36 realistic enterprise applications in backend/seed.py using lib/db.py and ensure it runs cleanly via `python seed.py`.
4. Store user favorites and user preferences (selected layout mode, preferred sort, dark/light theme) in localStorage so they persist seamlessly across page reloads without requiring user login.

5. Provide all 5 layouts: Grid (marketplace), List (tabular rows), Alphabetical (A-Z with jump nav), Category (collapsible category sections), and Compact (high density grid). Layout switching must be instantaneous with zero page reload.

6. Build App Detail modal with comprehensive description, category, direct URL, environment badge, status, launch button (which opens in a new tab AND calls the launch counter endpoint), and admin edit/delete buttons.
7. Include an Admin Dialog to Add/Edit/Delete applications with instant UI feedback via Sonner toast notifications.
8. Ensure all clickable buttons and inputs have the specified `data-testid` attributes for Playwright verification.

9. Update /app/frontend/src/index.css to import '@fontsource-variable/space-grotesk' and '@fontsource-variable/dm-sans', and apply the refined Swiss/High-Contrast Enterprise palette tokens in :root and .dark.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.visual_depth: Use crisp 1px borders (border-slate-200/80 dark:border-slate-800), subtle inner highlights, and layered box-shadows rather than flat muddy fills.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.anti_slop: Avoid generic centered cards with purple/pink neon glow. Use crisp tactical typography, distinct category color accents, and functional badge indicators.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.transitions: Never use transition: all. Use specific property transitions like `transition-[transform,opacity,background-color] duration-200`.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.buttons: Pill or clean 8px radius with clear hover and active depression states.
